text:
The court would likely find a contract at $1,000 because CIF (cost, insurance, and freight) means the seller's price includes all costs of loading and transporting the goods to the destination, so Costco's attempted $50/thousand loading charge is inconsistent with the CIF term and not part of the contract. Under UCC 2-207, Costco's additional term would be a material alteration and excluded absent clear assent.

CONFIDENCE: 85
